gdd.body: 第3次上盘转 dew_lantern; natural age only
base 2, no extra
第2次上盘转 amber_frond
consume self reward 4 independent of consumer
age-extra one adjacent plant +1; finished products skipped
each plant transform: self permanent +1, max 2/spin, cap 30
appearance: adj starting live fuel +3
summary: >=2 plant transforms then live plant ×3/2
consume spawn copper; 3 appearances then self-destroy reward 3
consume adj scrap reward 6; no target => base 1 only
adj any machine self +2
base -1, no extra, candidate false
transform adj junk to copper_burr, not delete
scrap consume => self permanent +1 /spin
destroy adj junk; listen non-consume junk destroy => one pressure +2
summary: consume >=2 distinct scrap types then each live machine ×3/2
appearance self + distinct other row resonance types cap 3
step5 adjacency-add one adj resonance +3 lockFirst
appearance adj starting mist +3
3rd appearance extra +9 reset beat
appearance: >=2 other adj resonance types, first neighbor ×2
appearance adj starting crystal +4
appearance row resonance count exactly 1 => +10
row >=3 distinct resonance types: that row resonance ×2 once
第2次上盘转 saline_ampoule
base 2 no extra
transform adj feedstock to tide_prism
on transform-into-self +3; direct draw base 4
consume adj mist reward 4 spawn saline
>=2 crystal types self +6
transform adj crystal non-product to tide_prism; tide already illegal
consume adj fuel reward 2 pressure +2 cap 6; at 6 reward 18
step5 adjacency-add lock first adj product +3
appearance >=3 cargo types self +4
appearance initial empty >=4 self +3
consume adj product reward 6+target base
appearance >=4 cargo types self ×3
reserve adj product next spin; commit step8 if still valid
preprocess majority adj plant/crystal/resonance tag
listen adj cargo consume product; step8 reward 8 if pool<=20
inject +1 cap4; at4 reward10 reset; ordinary still 1
consume adj fuel reward3 pressure +2 cap6
appearance copyable +1; adj pressure-tag +2 uncopyable
inject +1 cap3 reward16; ordinary always 0
3/4 +8; 1/4 -6 spawn gasket
reduce first adj pressure-risk fail loss by 4 min 0
step7 spend 3 from adj pressure>=3 below cap, ×3 + reward 8
cash<payment and remaining<=2: self ×4 spawn gasket
preprocess: adj resonance else crystal tag
appearance >=3 other adj types +4; not copyable
第3次上盘转 blank_facet; NATURAL age only, not fog_stitcher extra

copy adj copyable ON_APPEAR add cap 8
after preprocess, first legal adj by tagAdded RECORD order +5 lock, no retarget
listen adj grow actualIncrease×4, max 2
preprocess adj product +resonance+crystal and ×3/2
base -1, candidate false
cash*2<payment self +4
transform adj junk to cleared_stub
direct ON_APPEAR copyable +1; convert-into skips +1
consume adj junk reward 5 and self grow 1
cash deficit <=15 self +6; snapshot cash
if accepted: reward 18, payment +12, spawn arrears; default reject
summary: no junk and >=3 contract types: contract ×2
after natural age, first remaining aged plant +1
first plant transform survivor +4
draw plant weight ×3/2 if pool<=28
stage first 2 starting mist +3 each
first scrap consume extra reward +3
3rd non-consume junk destroy this stage: removeTokens +1
first consume non-junk scrap spawns ash_felt
draw junk weight ×1/2
summary each row-first resonance if row >=2 types +2
summary row with exactly 1 resonance ×3/2
first novel resonance tagAdded; commit +5 at step8 if alive
cycle_count threshold 3→2 via mechanics, not resolver ID
first feedstock→crystal product +4
first time live distinct crystal types >=3: reward 7
first converted crystal reserved at step8
first mist consume extra reward +2
summary >=4 cargo types reward 6
stage skip ordinals 1 and 3: rerollTokens +1 via mechanics
summary pool 12–20 reward 5
first product consume sets itemProductPending
first real pressure increase extra +1 no recurse
mechanics riskReduction 3 on first pressure fail
3rd successful release this stage reward 12
replace first risk junk spawn with source -3
first legal copy +2 cap 8 via mechanics.copyBonus
first novel tagAdded; +3 at step8 if alive; death cancels no retarget
first copy target reserved at step8
first positive growth reward min(6,2×actual)
cash*2<payment independent +3
first junk→nonjunk product +3
first successful payment this stage with no junk: removeTokens +1
last spin, cash in [3/4, payment): contract ×3/2. 5.I.1 appearance; §6 last-spin all contract
